issues.description: The problem statement and the template define Course.instructor as a String (and show the initializer taking a String), but the solution defines Course.instructor as [String]. Additionally, the solution's Client.swift calls Course initializer with a String for instructor while the solution Course initializer expects [String]. This cross-artifact/type mismatch is structural and causes the solution code to be inconsistent and not compile as-is, and it will confuse students about the expected type for the instructor property.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the instructor type consistent across all artifacts. Either (A) change the solution to use String for instructor (update Course.instructor to String and its initializer signature to accept a String, and keep Client.swift as-is), or (B) update the problem statement and template to specify instructor as [String] and update the example initializer and Client.swift to pass an array of instructor names. Ensure all references and printed messages handle the chosen type consistently.

issues.description: The conceptual entity 'instructor' is represented inconsistently across artifacts: the problem statement and the template expect Course.instructor to be a String (single instructor), but the solution's Course implementation declares instructor as [String] (an array). Additionally, the solution's Client constructs a Course using a String for instructor, which conflicts with the solution Course type. This mismatch breaks the clear mapping from the requirement to the implementation and will confuse students about the expected type/representation of an instructor.
issues.suggestedFix: Choose a single representation for Course.instructor and make it consistent in all artifacts. Either: (A) Keep instructor as a String (single combined name) — change the solution's Course to declare instructor: String and its initializer accordingly; or (B) Intentionally use an array [String] everywhere — update the problem statement examples and the template/Client to pass an array of instructor names. Aligning all three places (problem, template, solution/Client) will remove the mapping confusion.
